method: Direct inspection of both original viewport PNGs plus focused axe color-contrast results with unchanged scroll and element geometry.
cause: bg-background/88 generates no rule in this repository Tailwind configuration. Header background computes transparent, allowing the underlying real A2 CTA to become the contrast background of both gamification labels.
correction: The sole header class change to bg-background produces the solid design-token background #070a12. Both labels remain in the same positions while the underlying CTA no longer shows through.

scope.sourceVariant: Only bg-background/88 -> bg-background on the header; no repository source mutation by this probe

observations.observed: Green CTA shows through the fixed header behind Nivel 1 and 0 días. Both targets reproduce the CI failure.
Header is opaque; both labels are legible above the same underlying CTA. No new clipping, overlap or displacement is visible.

previousAttempt.outcome: Before variant reproduced both color-contrast targets; bundled single-process Chromium closed after its first browser context, before the second variant. This run launches a fresh browser for each variant.

limitations: Only the header color-contrast rule was audited; this is not a full-page accessibility certification.
